description: Creates up to 100 closeout requirements on the project. If any requirement is invalid, none are created and every invalid field is listed by index.

201.description: The created requirements, in request order

review_state.description: AI_UNREVIEWED until a person reviews an agent-created requirement.

400.description: Invalid fields, listed in errors; nothing was created

403.description: No permission to change Closeout on this project, or a missing CSRF token

502.description: Procore permissions could not be retrieved

requirements.description: Requirements to create, up to 100. If any is invalid, none are created.

title.description: Short item name the register lists the requirement by.

description.description: Summary of the requirement in one or two sentences.

type.description: What the requirement is. Sets kind when given.

kind.description: What has to happen for the requirement to be met. Required unless type is set; when type is set, kind is derived from it and, if sent, must match it.

categories.description: What the requirement is about. Drives grouping and filters.

necessity.description: Whether the requirement applies. Leave empty when the wording is unclear.

conditions.description: When the requirement applies, or any exceptions to it.

scope.description: The equipment, systems or work the requirement covers.

status.description: Tracking status. Defaults to NOT_STARTED. WAIVED and NOT_APPLICABLE need notes and can't be used when the origin is AGENT.

is_blocking.description: Whether project closeout is blocked until this is met. Defaults to false.

responsible_role.description: The role responsible for meeting the requirement.

responsible_company_id.description: Directory company (vendor) ID of the responsible company.

responsible_party.description: Who is responsible, as the source names them.

assignee.description: Who the work is assigned to, as the source names them.

due_trigger.description: The project event the due date depends on.

due_offset_days.description: Days after the due trigger (negative for before). Needs a due_trigger other than FIXED_DATE.

due_date.description: Due date, only when it is known. Never estimated.

due_timing.description: When the requirement is due, in the source's words.

completeness_criteria.description: What has to be included for the requirement to be complete.

verification.description: How meeting the requirement is verified.

expected_evidence.description: What has to be handed over to prove the requirement is met.

system.description: Building system the requirement applies to.

source_type.description: Type of the record the requirement was found in.

source_id.description: ID of the source record. Needs source_type.

source_document.description: File name and revision of the source document.

source_page.description: Page of the source document, starting at 1.

source_location_label.description: Where in the source the requirement is.

source_quote.description: Exact text from the source that states the requirement.

confidence.description: How sure the extractor is that the requirement reflects the source.

confidence_reason.description: Why confidence is MEDIUM or LOW.

origin.description: Who is creating the requirement. Defaults to USER. AGENT requirements start unreviewed.
